purpose: Exact upstream baseline selected by implementation step S0.1. Reviewable without an implicit clone.

acquisition.soleSourceBootstrapPath: git submodule add of NVIDIA-RTX/Donut at the locked commit, then git submodule update --init --recursive
notes: Donut is designed to be consumed as a Git submodule. Recursive submodule init is the sole source bootstrap path.
Donut/NVRHI/ShaderMake CMake FetchContent is accepted only for the two pinned packages those projects already fetch: DirectX-Headers and the DXC release zip.
S0.2 must pass the exact DirectX-Headers commit below as NVRHI_DIRECTX_HEADERS_GIT_TAG. Do not leave the upstream default preview tag in place.
Optional Donut FetchContent packages (Streamline, DLSS, Agility SDK, Aftermath, RTXMU, Vulkan-Headers, Slang) are not part of this baseline.
